title: Extract task title normalization without changing behavior
body:
Simulation case: routine
Rules added, changed, and removed (give IDs or write none): none. The SIMULATED FEATURE REQUEST and SIMULATED PRODUCT RULES stay in effect.
Old behavior: The API removes leading and trailing whitespace from task titles with an inline call to strip.
New behavior: The same call is in normalize_title. Task selection, persistence, and API responses follow the same rules.
Tests added: [api/tests/test_task_text.py](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/blob/3839aca5214cc0a013784902302cbb6e35915c05/api/tests/test_task_text.py)
Tests removed: none
Relevant tests and runs: [exact change](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/commit/3839aca5214cc0a013784902302cbb6e35915c05) [hosted checks](https://github.com/lev999/ai-code-review-demo/actions/runs/45896107761)
Reviewer role: not required
